subject: prd/impl-review
statement: The reviewer's verdict shall be one of approve · approve-with-advisories · request-changes · escalate; the verdict shall carry downgrade-only authority, emitting a signal that may route a proposal to the HUMAN lane or back to the worker and that can never grant AUTO or record a stage-9 sign-off.
rationale: the program verdict set; GATE-4's one-way precedent
fit_criterion: schema-level: no verdict value or side effect widens lane eligibility or writes a gate signature; the lane fixture shows HUMAN-forcing works and AUTO-granting is unrepresentable
